node.statement: Local corner threshold, independent of node 1.1. The root conclusion is existential in the single universal witness e_s2. Since the registered external lem-compcb-corner-algebra supplies a universal e_ca>0, impose in constructing that witness the additional restriction 0<e_s2<=e_ca/2 (intersecting any other positive universal restrictions with e_ca/2 preserves positivity). Then the root hypotheses epsilon_A<=t<=e_s2 give t+epsilon_A<=2*t<=2*e_s2<=e_ca. Thus the external's required defect threshold holds without using node 1.1 or any additivity threshold.
